PARAMS = {
    "W1":  (20.0, 8.0, 60.0),     # input pair width (um), weak inversion
    "L1":  (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),       # input pair L
    "W3":  (4.0, 2.0, 10.0),      # PMOS mirror width (L=0.5), 8uA each
    "W7":  (60.0, 30.0, 120.0),   # PMOS CS 2nd stage width (L=0.5)
    "Cc":  (0.8e-12, 0.4e-12, 1.5e-12),
    "Rz":  (2500.0, 800.0, 6000.0),
    "m8":  (60, 40, 75),          # output sink fingers (2uA/finger)
    "mt":  (8, 6, 14),            # tail fingers (2uA/finger)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec["cl"]; iref = spec["iref"]
    Lb, Wu = 2.0, 2.0            # unit bias finger: W=2, L=2 -> 2uA per finger
    mref = 5                     # 10uA reference -> 2uA/finger
    iu = iref / mref
    m8 = int(round(p["m8"])); mt = int(round(p["mt"]))
    itail = mt * iu; i1 = itail / 2; i7 = m8 * iu
    W1, L1, W3, W7 = p["W1"], p["L1"], p["W3"], p["W7"]
    L3 = 0.5
    Cc, Rz = p["Cc"], p["Rz"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: ibias diode, tail and output sinks
    n.M("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wu * mref, Lb, m=mref)
    n.M("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wu * mt, Lb, m=mt)
    n.M("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wu * m8, Lb, m=m8)
    # input pair: vinp drives M1 (to diode side) -> non-inverting overall
    n.M("M1", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1, m=2)
    n.M("M2", "o1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1, m=2)
    # PMOS mirror load
    n.M("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W3, L3)
    n.M("M4", "o1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W3, L3)
    # second stage PMOS CS
    n.M("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W7, L3, m=4)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cc", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cc", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    gm_id1 = 20.0                     # weak inversion, ~0.4uA/um
    gm1 = gm_id1 * i1
    VA_n05, VA_p05, VA_n2 = 8.0, 8.4, 20.0
    gds2 = i1 / VA_n05; gds4 = i1 / VA_p05
    gm7 = 11.0 * i7
    gds7 = i7 / VA_p05; gds8 = i7 / VA_n2
    A1 = gm1 / (gds2 + gds4); A2 = gm7 / (gds7 + gds8)
    gain_db = 20 * math.log10(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = 0.3e-12
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (C1 * cl + Cc * (C1 + cl)) / (2 * PI)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * max(Rz - 1.0 / gm7, 1.0))
    gm3 = 10.0 * i1
    pm3 = gm3 / (2 * PI * 60e-15) / 2
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (1 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1))))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + itail + i7)
    slew = min(itail / Cc, i7 / (cl + Cc))
    gds5 = itail / VA_n2
    cmrr_db = 20 * math.log10(max(2 * gm1 * (10.0 * i1) / (gds5 * (gds2 + gds4)), 1.0))
    psrr_db = gain_db - 6
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise = math.sqrt(2 * 8 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + (10.0 * i1) / gm1)) * 8  # thermal x flicker factor
    settle = 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.8) + 0.8 / slew
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db,
               "noise_1k": noise, "settle": settle, "swing": 1.6, "polarity": 1}
